statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains well below the block threshold on an observed flat, mid-range overnight tape, while Stress stays elevated because the July PCE block and the Nvidia results fall in the same session.

headline: NQ flat and mid-range into the European session as oil extends its Hormuz slide; conditional risk stays concentrated in the PCE and Nvidia windows
body: Nasdaq-100 futures near 29,236-29,254 are roughly 0.1-0.15% below the prior settlement and sit mid-range inside an overnight 29,096.00-29,309.75 band about 0.7% wide. That band has now held for a full overnight session, which is the clearest available evidence that retracements are still occurring rather than failing, and no session extreme is being held. The NDX cash index closed Tuesday at 29,209.23, up 0.64%, inside a 29,077.72-29,338.77 range and roughly 130 points below its high, so the cash session also ended without an extreme hold. European cash markets opened firmer, with reporting attributing the tone to the continued crude decline and to falling bond yields, while US futures were little changed; that mild divergence is consistent with two-sided trade rather than directional extension. Delayed cross-asset context shows NQ near -0.16%, ES near -0.11%, YM unchanged, VX near flat and the Treasury futures strip inside 0.11%, so nothing is aligned toward a one-way impulse. VIX is at 15.45, unchanged from Tuesday's close and well below stress levels. Crude has extended its decline: WTI is near $80.3 and Brent near $86.6, both down more than 2% on the day and roughly 8% on the week, after Iran and Oman resumed talks on a temporary joint navigational corridor through the Strait of Hormuz and reports circulated of a US-Iran ceasefire. Investing.com noted it could not independently verify the ceasefire report. The direction of the geopolitical input is therefore de-escalation, which is disinflationary and index-supportive at the margin rather than a discontinuity that would amplify Tail. Yields are contained: the Federal Reserve H.15 release shows the 2-year at 4.24% and the 10-year at 4.70% on 24 August, and overnight reporting describes flat-to-lower Treasury yields alongside the crude move. Leadership is narrow rather than broad, which also argues against a single aligned index-level trend: megacaps closed split four up and four down with a median change of 0.12%, while semiconductors were firm with NVDA up 2.19%, AMD up 4.91% and MU up 2.48%. Against that, the scheduled catalyst stack for this session is unusually dense. July core PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP, durable goods and personal income and spending all print together at 12:30Z, one hour before the US cash open, with consensus at 3.6% headline and 3.3% core year-on-year. Nvidia then reports after the close, with the analyst call an hour later. No release outcome, earnings result or post-event price path is known at the assessment cutoff, and none is treated as observed. Consistent with the risk definitions, that combination raises Stress and keeps Confidence high without raising current Tail: the observed path is two-sided, volatility is subdued and no persistent one-way structure, shallow-pullback sequence or session-extreme hold is present.

lookbackSummary: Across the last 24 published hourly assessments the mapped state was green apart from a five-hour yellow WATCH stretch between 09:00Z and 13:00Z on 25 August, when Tail sat at 20-21% during a trend-up phase. Tail peaked at 21% and then decayed steadily to 9-12% through the US afternoon and the overnight session, while the dominant mode moved from trend-up to mixed and then to normal. Stress held in a 45-52% band, with its highest prints in the last five hours as the day's catalyst stack came into view, and Confidence stayed in a tight 84-88% range. The series therefore describes a tape that calmed steadily while scheduled event risk accumulated ahead of it.
outlookSummary: The forward 24 hours contain two distinct scheduled clusters. The first is the 12:30Z macro block, where core PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP and durable goods print together; conditional Tail is modelled at 22-23% through the release and the 13:30Z US cash open, mapping to a yellow WATCH state, before easing back through the US morning. The second is the Nvidia sequence, with results expected shortly after the 20:00Z close and the analyst call at 21:00Z, where conditional Tail is modelled at 26-27% and crosses into the orange BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES band for 20:00-22:00 UTC, then steps down overnight. Between and after those clusters the modelled path returns toward a 12-17% baseline. All forward structure is conditional: no post-release or post-earnings price path is treated as observed, and an orderly path with visible retracements would justify faster decay than modelled here.
